This page covers the website and enquiries sent through it. How I handle project data is set out under [Confidentiality and data handling](consulting.qmd#confidentiality-and-data-handling).

## What the website collects

- **Page counts.** The site uses GoatCounter to count page views. It sets no cookies and does not build a profile of individual visitors.
- **Hosting.** The site is hosted on GitHub Pages. GitHub may record the internet address of each visitor in its server logs.
- **Fonts.** The typefaces are loaded from Google Fonts, so your browser contacts Google when a page loads.
- **No advertising.** The site carries no ads and no advertising trackers.

## When you contact me

If you email me, I receive your name, your email address, and whatever you choose to write. I use that information to reply and, if we work together, to carry out and keep a record of the work. My email is provided by Apple iCloud Mail.

I do not sell or share your information, and I do not add you to a mailing list.

## How long I keep it

I keep enquiry emails for as long as they are needed to respond and to keep a record of work done. If nothing comes of an enquiry, you can ask me to delete it at any time.

## Your requests

You can ask to see the information I hold about you, to have it corrected, or to have it deleted. Email [consulting@rckaruna.ca](mailto:consulting@rckaruna.ca). I am the person responsible for privacy for this practice.
